Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
A vampire with an untapped Helicopter is in torpor. Another vampire
without a vehicle diablerizes and takes the Helicopter. Does the
Helicopter tap?

"When a minion equips with the Helicopter, tap it. After resolving a
successful action, this minion may tap the Helicopter to untap. A
minion may have only one vehicle."

I assume not because the dialerist is taking a diablerie action which
has the side effect of gaining equipment (sometimes).

TIA.

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Side effect isn't really the issue. The issue is whether he's equipping (like
Pier 13) or whether you're just moving the equipment card (like Redistribution).

The rule reads like a simple change of control, so it's just movement. The
Helicopter doesn't tap.
